import json, random, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tools')
from controller import run
from brute import brute
import verify
from fractions import Fraction

def bigtarget_case(rng):
    S = rng.randint(1, 5); F = rng.randint(1, 4); G = rng.randint(0, 3)
    J = rng.randint(0, 7); tmax = rng.randint(4, 40)
    groups = [[(-1 if (g == 0 or rng.random() < 0.4) else rng.randrange(g)), rng.randint(0, 10)] for g in range(G)]
    flows = [[rng.randint(1, 20), 0, 0, 0] for _ in range(F)]
    for f in range(F):
        flows[f][1] = rng.randint(flows[f][0], 24)
        flows[f][2] = -1 if (G == 0 or rng.random() < 0.3) else rng.randrange(G)
        flows[f][3] = rng.randrange(7)
    times = sorted(rng.sample(range(0, tmax + 1), S))
    slots = [[t, rng.randint(0, 5), 0 if i == 0 else rng.randint(0, 5)] for i, t in enumerate(times)]
    windows = [[rng.randrange(F), rng.randint(0, tmax), 0, rng.randint(1, 65535), rng.randint(1, 320),
                rng.choice([0, 0, rng.randint(0, 65535)]), rng.randint(1, 30),
                [[rng.randint(0, 1500), rng.randint(0, 2560)] for _ in range(9)]] for _ in range(J)]
    for w in windows:
        w[2] = rng.randint(w[1], tmax)
    return {'model': rng.choice(['cnn','rnn']),
            'class_values': [rng.randint(1, 50) for _ in range(7)],
            'stats': [rng.randint(1, 60), rng.randint(1, 60), rng.randint(1, 150)],
            'bucket': [rng.randint(1, 4), 0], 'slots': slots, 'flows': flows,
            'groups': groups, 'windows': windows}

def main():
    count = int(sys.argv[1]); seed = int(sys.argv[2])
    rng = random.Random(seed); bad = 0
    for trial in range(count):
        case = bigtarget_case(rng)
        out = run(json.dumps({'version':3,'cases':[case]}).encode())
        if 'error' in out:
            print(trial, 'invalid!'); bad += 1; continue
        res = out['results'][0]
        errs = verify.check(case, res); errs = verify.check_reports(case, res, errs)
        ref = brute(case)
        got = (Fraction(res['ratio'][0], res['ratio'][1]), res['utility'], res['age'])
        if got != (ref[0], ref[1], ref[2]):
            errs.append('brute mismatch %r vs %r' % (got, (ref[0], ref[1], ref[2])))
        if errs:
            bad += 1; print(trial, 'FAILED', errs[:5])
            json.dump(case, open('/tmp/bfail_%d_%d.json' % (seed, trial), 'w'))
    print('done %d trials %d failures' % (count, bad))
    return bad
sys.exit(1 if main() else 0)
PYEOF
